text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...How... is it? It's been a while since I 
did traditional media, but... I think... 
it turned out well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Painted on the canvas was Loves Only You, 
gazing up at a rainbow with both hands 
outstretched.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light spills out from the rainbow, 
scattering across the shot to create a 
fantastical image.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: This light... Could it be the fans...?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. ...T-That's the plan. ...Ehehe. 
You can always tell, can't you? Does this 
look good for tonight's stream thumbnail?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful... Maru-chan. Thank you so 
much, as always.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Maru-chan started helping out 
with the illustrations and designs, I feel 
like our fans have been smiling so much 
more.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...How can I ever return all the love 
Maru-chan gives me? It's overflowing and I 
just can't stop!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's... just getting the chance to do 
it makes me happy... and it's fun. 
...Besides...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
When Love-chan smiles... I-I... can 
really... you know, feel it... Y-Your 
love...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Aww, thank you as always! I loooove 
you!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Eep……!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You watched the stream too, didn't you?! 
Well? Wasn't it absolutely wonderful?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You watched the stream too, didn't you?! 
Well? Wasn't it absolutely wonderful?!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! Thanks to that, we're getting 
a whole bunch of comments!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... Just saying thanks really isn't 
enough! Hey, how should I give all this 
love back to you?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Just the thought is more than enough~! 
The fans' comments, and Loves-chan's words 
too... Every time I hear them, I feel so 
happy☆"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, absolutely not! Because I'm not 
satisfied yet! You'll have to accept it 
properly!
choice_data_list:
How about... expressing your gratitude in 
a letter?

How about trying to draw a picture of 
Marche Lorraine?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――Wonderful! A love letter, isn't it? ♡ 
Packed with plenty of love, I'll give 
Maru-chan the one and only love letter in 
the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ufufu. Look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You looking thrilled, and 
Marche Lorraine flustered yet clearly 
happy. It was a heartwarming afternoon 
watching the two close friends.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
! This time it's my turn to draw you, 
Maru-chan! ...I might not be able to draw 
as well as you do, but I'll give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
R...'Really? Loves-chan did that to 
Maru-chan...?'

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. 'I can't wait! This is definitely 
going to be a family heirloom!'

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Oh, Maru-chan, I haven't even drawn 
it yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marche Lorraine's eyes shone with 
excitement. How she would be portrayed—no 
doubt it would be a work overflowing with 
love.
